c00-sample-directed.description: schemas/sample.hif.json verbatim: directed, 8 nodes with attrs, 3 weighted edges with attrs, 9 role-labelled incidences with direction, nested metadata

c01-sample-undirected.description: the sample with network-type undirected and every direction field removed

c02-undirected-with-direction.description: the sample with network-type undirected but direction fields kept

c03-no-network-type.description: the sample with the network-type key removed (direction fields kept)

c04-asc.description: the sample declared as an abstract simplicial complex (network-type asc), direction removed

c05-two-roles-same-direction.description: one node plays two roles in one directed edge, both on the tail: two incidence records for the same (edge, node) pair with different roles and different incidence weights

c06-two-roles-different-direction.description: one node plays two roles in one directed edge, once on the tail (regulator) and once on the head (target): gene autoregulation

c07-two-roles-undirected.description: c05 in an undirected network (no direction fields)

c08-isolated-nodes.description: two declared nodes that occur in no incidence, one with attrs and one without

c09-empty-edges.description: two declared edges that have no incidences, one with attrs and one without

c10-nested-fact.description: a nested fact: edge id f1 is also used as a node id, a participant of edge m1 (an assertion about f1)

c11-integer-ids.description: integer node and edge ids; edge id 0 equals node id 0

c12-mixed-int-str-ids.description: the integer 1 and the string "1" used as two different node ids, and as two different edge ids

c13-unicode-ids.description: non-ASCII node, edge and role strings; NFC and NFD spellings of 'e-acute' as two distinct nodes

c14-directed-missing-direction.description: network-type directed but one incidence has no direction field (schema-valid)

c15-incidence-attrs-absent-or-empty.description: incidences with attrs {role}, with attrs {} and with no attrs key

c16-attr-value-shapes.description: attrs (on nodes, edges, incidences and metadata) holding lists, nested dicts, null, booleans, non-ASCII text, empty list/object, an integer above 2^53 and a tiny float

c17-weights-everywhere.description: record-level weight on nodes, edges and incidences

c18-weight-key-inside-attrs.description: no record-level weight anywhere, but a key named 'weight' inside node, edge and incidence attrs

c19-duplicate-node-edge-records.description: node n1 and edge e1 each declared twice with different attrs (upstream calls this HIF-compliant)

c20-hnx-reserved-metadata-keys.description: metadata carries the keys HyperNetX interprets (name, default_attrs with a default 'role'); one incidence has no role

c21-node-attr-key-equals-python-paramete.description: an isolated node whose attrs contain the key 'node' (the name of the XGI add_node parameter)

c22-nan-in-attrs.description: a NaN value in node and incidence attrs (not strict JSON; Python's json accepts it)

c23-big-int-ids.description: integer ids at and beyond 2^53 and 2^63

c24-empty-incidences.description: the smallest valid HIF document: incidences is an empty array

c26-edge-attr-key-equals-python-paramete.description: an empty edge whose attrs contain the keys 'members' and 'idx' (XGI add_edge parameter names)

c25-plain-no-attrs.description: an undirected hypergraph with no attrs, weights, nodes or edges arrays
